{{AnimeLocationInfobox |name=Wales Island |characters=ウェルズ島 |japanese=Wells Island |image=Wales Island.png |imagesize=250px |caption=Sky view of Wales Island |region=Hoenn |epicode=AG102 |episode=Where's Armaldo? }} '''Wales Island''' (Japanese: '''ウェルズ島''' ''Wells Island'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location in [[Hoenn]], featured in ''[[AG102|Where's Armaldo?]]''. It is a crescent-shaped island located somewhere between [[Mossdeep City]] and [[Sootopolis City]]. There is a town located on one side of the island, while the rest of the island is uninhabited by humans and considered to be a nature preserve. [[Professor Proctor]] and his wife [[Annie Proctor|Annie]] live on the island and also run a [[Fossil]] laboratory there, where they have resurrected several ancient {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}. Initially, the Professor hoped to invite people from all around the {{pkmn|world}} to the island so they could see the Pokémon. However, after an {{p|Armaldo}} went on a rampage, the couple decided to abandon these plans. They instead promised {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} that they would keep the island a secret and work hard to make sure the Pokémon would be safe. According to {{an|Brock}}'s handbook, Wales Island has remained unchanged for 1,000 years, and ancient [[Berry]] trees continue to grow on one of Wales Island's capes. Professor Proctor showed Ash and his friends a simulation of the island's history, which explained that the island was once part of the mainland thousands of years ago, but rising waters led to its geographical isolation. Wales Island remained home to {{p|Anorith}}, {{p|Lileep}}, and their evolved forms {{p|Armaldo}} and {{p|Cradily}}, but they became {{wp|Extinction|extinct}} more recently. ==Pokémon seen on Wales Island== {| style="margin:auto; width: 50%" |- | {{InactivePoké|Wales Island|Breloom|Wales Island Breloom.png|Grass|Fighting|link=no}} | {{InactivePoké|Wales Island|Lileep|Wales Island Lileep.png|disp=Lileep (×3)|Rock|Grass|link=no}} | {{InactivePoké|Wales Island|Cradily|Wales Island Cradily.png|Rock|Grass|link=no}} | {{InactivePoké|Wales Island|Armaldo|Wales Island Armaldo.png|Rock|Bug|link=no|fir=Anorith}} | |} ==Trivia== *Wales Island may have been named after {{wp|Wales|the country of the same name}}, where many fossils have been found.
